# Unpredictable: Cozy Runner

> Unpredictable is a free, cozy one-thumb runner for Android by Abyte Labs. Players run as one of eight friends (Sprig, Bun, Kit, Momo, Rex, Pip, Cap and Bolt), dress them up from a wardrobe, and run three roads full of fair surprises: jump and duck at the right moment, collect seeds, and see how far you get. It is in closed testing on Google Play.
